faq_heading: Homes near Katzie Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Katzie Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Katzie Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Katzie Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Katzie Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Hazelgrove Elementary (0.7 km west), Crescent Heights Academy (1.1 km south) and Langley Meadows Elementary (1.3 km south-east).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Katzie Elementary

17 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Katzie Elementary in a straight line (11 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other, 1 middle; 2 independent). The closest is Hazelgrove Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Donna Gabriel Robins Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Clayton Heights Secondary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is Crescent Heights Academy (1.1 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Salish Secondary (2.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Hazelgrove Elementary (0.7 km west), Langley Meadows Elementary (1.3 km south-east), Maddaugh Elementary (1.3 km north), R C Garnett Demonstration Elementary (1.6 km east), Regent Road Elementary (1.7 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Hazelgrove Elementary, 0.7 km west of Katzie Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Katzie Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Katzie Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Katzie Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Look at Hazelgrove Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km west of Katzie Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
